name: San Antonio (Tolima, Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of San Antonio dated 1925.
history: Municipal flag of San Antonio, a municipality in the department of Tolima, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: San Antonio arms — green shield dated 1925, held by two hands
